elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) expressly warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) warrants that the Site and any software provided by HDI will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty lasts only ninety days following delivery.
The Services warranty lasts only thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The stated remedy includes repair or replacement of the non-conforming Site or software, as well as re-performance of Services.
The stated remedy includes a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming Site, software, or Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: HDI gives no warranty that its performance, Services, Site, or software complies with applicable laws.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no warranty regarding malicious code.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) warrants for ninety days following delivery that any software provided by HDI will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) provides a thirty-day warranty for Services following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedy expressly includes repair or replacement of the non-conforming Site or software and re-performance of non-conforming Services.
The remedy expressly includes a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming Site, software, or Services.
